release_notes:
[WINDOWS-ONLY TEST — TEMPORARY]
Manifest ini hanya menyediakan Windows x64. macOS clients tidak mendapat paket sampai manifest multi-platform lengkap diterbitkan.

AutoCleanFeatureX V6.67.1 by Elmo
Windows x64 — Temporary Validation Release

Changes:
- Moved Delete Create controls into a dedicated group, separate from Cleanup.
- Placed the Delete Create group below the USING section.
- Preserved the existing application functionality and configuration.

Update validation:
- Windows x64 package only.
- Intended for testing the automatic update from V6.67.0 to V6.67.1.
- SHA-256 package integrity and Ed25519 manifest signature verification are required.

Important:
- This is a temporary Windows-only validation release.
- macOS Intel and Apple Silicon packages are not included in this test manifest.
- Internal CSAdmin, SDP, and DNS features require appropriate company VPN and access permissions.
- Do not treat this release as the final cross-platform distribution.
